name: Peninsula Gardens | 1g Pre-Roll | Weekend At Gary's
description: Bahama Mama x Gary Payton. The old school grape flavor we all remember but with a kick of funk mixed into it from the Gary Payton. Dark purple bud’s give it beautiful bag appeal. A good strong high with a great flavor.
